questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) The perpendicular from the centre of a circle to a chord bisects the chord.
(ii) Equal chords are equidistant from the centre.
(iii) The longest chord of a circle is the radius.
(iv) A chord divides the circle into two arcs.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) TRUE. (ii) TRUE. (iii) FALSE: Longest chord is diameter. (iv) TRUE. Option B wrong (iii false). Option C wrong (iv correct). Option D wrong (iii false).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The angle in a semicircle is always 90 degrees.
Reason (R): The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circle equals half the angle at the centre (180/2 = 90).

Choose the correct option:
options: (A) is not correct but (R) is correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) correct: Thales theorem. (R) correct: Centre angle=180, circumference=90. (R) explains (A). Option B wrong (R IS explanation). Option C wrong (R correct). Option D wrong (A correct).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: Two tangents from an external point make angle 60 degrees. The angle at the centre subtended by the chord joining points of tangency is:
questions.explanation: Quadrilateral: 60+90+90+centre=360. Centre=120. 100 wrong. 140 wrong. 110 wrong.

Column II:

(iv) Equals 90 degrees
questions.explanation: (a)=90=(iv). (b)=2x=(iii). (c)=equal=(ii). (d)=supplementary=(i). Option A swaps (a)(b). Option C swaps (b)(c). Option D all wrong.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are properties of tangents from an external point?

(i) Two tangents are equal in length.
(ii) They subtend equal angles at centre.
(iii) Tangents are always perpendicular to each other.
(iv) Line from external point to centre bisects angle between tangents.
questions.explanation: (i) TRUE. (ii) TRUE. (iii) FALSE: Not always perpendicular. (iv) TRUE. Option A wrong (iii false). Option B wrong (iv correct). Option D wrong (ii,iv correct).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are correct about angles in a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD?

(i) If angle A=70, then angle C=110.
(ii) If angle B=95, then angle D=85.
(iii) If angle A=angle C, then each must be 90.
(iv) The sum of all four angles is 180.
questions.explanation: (i) TRUE: 180-70=110. (ii) TRUE: 180-95=85. (iii) TRUE: If A=C and A+C=180, each=90. (iv) FALSE: Sum of all 4=360 not 180. Option B wrong (iii correct). Option C wrong (iv false). Option D wrong (ii correct).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:

(i) If OM perpendicular to AB, then AM=MB.
(ii) If AB=CD, distances from O are equal.
(iii) Perpendicular bisector of any chord passes through O.
(iv) Chord closer to centre is shorter.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) TRUE. (ii) TRUE. (iii) TRUE. (iv) FALSE: Closer=LONGER. Option A wrong (iii correct). Option C wrong (iv false). Option D wrong (iv false).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: (A) correct. (R) correct: Shortest distance=radius means perpendicular. (R) explains (A). Option A wrong (A correct). Option B wrong (R correct). Option C wrong (R IS explanation).

questions.explanation: (i) TRUE. (ii) TRUE. (iii) FALSE. (iv) TRUE. Option B wrong (iii false). Option C wrong (ii correct). Option D wrong (iii false, iv correct).

questions.explanation: (i) TRUE. (ii) FALSE: Tangent touches at one point. (iii) TRUE. (iv) TRUE. Option A wrong (ii false). Option B wrong (iv correct). Option D wrong (ii false).

questions.questionText:

(i) Inscribed angle = half central angle for same arc.
(ii) Inscribed angles on same arc are equal.
(iii) Angle in major arc (subtending minor arc) is acute.
(iv) Angle in minor arc (subtending major arc) is obtuse.

questions.explanation: All TRUE. (i) Theorem. (ii) Same arc same angle. (iii) Minor arc means centre angle<180, inscribed<90. (iv) Major arc means centre>180, inscribed>90. Option A wrong (iii,iv correct). Option C wrong (ii correct). Option D wrong (i,ii correct).

questions.explanation: (A) correct. (R) correct. (R) explains (A): equidistant point on perp bisector. Option B wrong (R correct). Option C wrong (A correct). Option D wrong (R IS explanation).

questions.subject: E

(i) Angles subtended by same chord on same side of chord are equal.
(ii) Angles subtended by same chord on opposite sides are supplementary.
(iii) If a chord subtends 35 degrees at major arc, it subtends 145 degrees at minor arc.
(iv) If a chord subtends 35 degrees at major arc, it subtends 70 degrees at centre.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) TRUE: Same segment theorem. (ii) TRUE: Opposite arcs supplementary. (iii) TRUE: 180-35=145. (iv) TRUE: Centre angle=2x circumference=70. All correct. Option B wrong (iv correct). Option C wrong (ii,iv correct). Option D wrong (i,iii correct).
